# Rework round 9 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R8-1: closed — the payoff quote's issue scope is now stated directly in record terms and no longer refers to the hold rule's selection. This policy issues the refinance-purpose quote of a loan that meets three tests: its interest paid-through date is fewer than two whole calendar months before the quote date; its AutoPay record shows at most one enrollment and at most one cancellation in those two whole months; and it has at most one additional-principal payment posted fewer than one whole calendar month before the quote date. Any other refinance-purpose quote is an ordinary payoff quote under loan_evt_payoff_quote. Compute tests exactly these three counts and computes the ordinary quote (good through the validity days, simple interest at the current rate, principal plus interest plus fees) when they fail. Inside the scope, the window, hold and day-rate rules see every record they need: every AutoPay change after the paid-through date falls inside the two-month count, and every additional-principal payment that could still be on hold falls inside the one-month count. The auditor's two-extra-payment case and its neighbours now each have a single reading.
PLS-R8-1 class sweep: closed — every scope or eligibility condition in the six rules was listed. Each names its object directly or counts records directly: the late fee's oldest unpaid installment, the returned fee's latest returned payment, the courtesy waiver's latest late fee with no fee payment, the refinance application and the enrollment it describes, and the quote's record counts. None is phrased through another rule's selection.
Proof text: closed — the task-0 hold trace, day-rate necessity text and plain trace now state the scope facts in the same record terms. Tier labels, baseline results and edge copies re-check clean.
R8-O1, R4-O1, R3-O1, R2-O3, R2-O4: carried — unchanged.
